Local patches to litehtml-sys 0.2.5 (https://github.com/franzos/litehtml-rs, MIT AND BSD-3-Clause AND Apache-2.0)
so that it builds with MSVC. Everything else is unchanged from the published crate.

- build.rs: do not link `stdc++` on MSVC; compile with /utf-8 and /permissive-; add `compat/` to
  the gumbo include path.
- compat/strings.h: POSIX <strings.h> shim (strcasecmp/strncasecmp) for MSVC.
- csrc/litehtml_c.cpp: pass `std::string` to `css::parse_css_stylesheet` in
  `lh_document_add_stylesheet`; the `const char*` instantiation is never emitted, which fails to link.
- csrc/litehtml_c.cpp: `lh_document_create_from_string` appends a caller-supplied master CSS to
  litehtml's built-in master CSS instead of replacing it (replacing it removes all element defaults).

Drop this directory and the `[patch.crates-io]` entry in the workspace Cargo.toml once upstream
builds on MSVC.
